name: uk.quickcloud/qc-mcp
description: QuickCloud hosting from your AI assistant: VMs, servers, DNS, firewalls and more. Read-only default.

environmentVariables.name: QC_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Your QuickCloud API key (create one in the panel under API). A read-only or product-limited key is the safest to give an assistant.

environmentVariables.name: QC_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Panel origin. Only needed if your provider runs QuickCloud on their own domain (default https://cloud.quickhost.uk).

environmentVariables.name: QC_MCP_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to allow the assistant to create and change things (equivalent to the --allow-write flag). Every write still asks for your confirmation.
